instruction: Clean both spills beside the north wall of the northern bedroom (there are two bedrooms), both beside the south wall in the living room, and the spill under the supply carton. Leave all other powder and the woven rug untouched. The job slip on top of the study bookcase shows the final parking mat. Push the carton onto the linen mat just inside the laundry, then back to the indicated foyer mat. Return the vacuum to the dock. Both robots start facing north.
